title: Start-Up Funding

Horizontal And Vertical Analysis Of Financial
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a kind of loan for which land or any other specific asset is offered as collateral security for the repayment of the funds involved in the credit facility."
Mortgage is a kind of loan for which land or any other specific asset is offered as collateral security for the repayment of the funds involved in the credit facility.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the income statement and the balance sheet."
The relevant financial statements are the income statement and the balance sheet.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a short-term loan which is normally obtained by a firm to finance its day-to-day operations."
The working capital loan is a short-term loan which is normally obtained by a firm to finance its day-to-day operations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the type of bond which is issued by large, well known industrial company."
A debenture is the type of bond which is issued by large, well known industrial company.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to relating the total value of the current assets to the total of the current Liabilities."
Current Ratio The current ratio refers to relating the total value of the current assets to the total of the current Liabilities.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the net profits from the operations of the business, indicative of total revenue less all expenses, and combined with non-cash expenses such as the amount of depreciation of capital assets."

The net cash inflows is the net profits from the operations of the business, indicative of total revenue less all expenses, and combined with non-cash expenses such as the amount of depreciation of capital assets.
fib: ______ is a major consideration in the determination of loss on default because the collateral security serves as a safety valve.
The security issue is a major consideration in the determination of loss on default because the collateral security serves as a safety valve.
______ is the personal integrity of the customer requesting for the loan, which is relation to his business dealings with the bank and other banks.
Character This consideration is the personal integrity of the customer requesting for the loan, which is relation to his business dealings with the bank and other banks.
______ is a financial contract acknowledging a debt which is separate and distinct from the transaction going rise to the debt.
Bill of Exchange Bill of Exchange is a financial contract acknowledging a debt which is separate and distinct from the transaction going rise to the debt.
______ is the plan that is designed to take care of accumulated payments.
Repayment Plan The repayment plan is the plan that is designed to take care of accumulated payments.
______ is the device normally employed to assess the specific aspects of the financial representation of the business operations.
The ratio analysis is the device normally employed to assess the specific aspects of the financial representation of the business operations.
______ refers to the risk arising from the use of short term liabilities to finance long term assets.
Liquidity risk refers to the risk arising from the use of short term liabilities to finance long term assets.
